title: Air Data & Pitot-Static Sensors
summary: Forward-fuselage air data sensors measuring pitot-static pressure, angle of attack, and sideslip for the flight control computers.
role: Supplies redundant airspeed, altitude, and Mach data to the triplex digital flight control system.
